summary: Circumstantial evidence standard under Sharad Birdhichand Sarda; last seen presumption; discovery/recovery panchnama validity; Section 8 Evidence Act applicability; bite mark/sexual assault/injuries evidence; conviction under IPC 302/364/377 and POCSO Sections 4/6; death sentence confirmation challenged; appeal allowed due to insufficient evidence meeting 'must be' standard.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and death sentence set aside; accused acquitted.
